components.name: Polymorphic Defunctionalization Through Lambda Set Specialization (the starter's default song and its timed lyrics)

relationships.basis: Every example's tracked files from examples/ but its demo (its (demo …) spec): its src/main.roc, its header naming the release's platform bundle URL; the starter's other modules, its logic package (logic/) and its fuzz targets (tests/fuzz/main.roc, whose header names roc-fuzz 0.7.0's platform by its content-addressed URL, which the compiler fetches only when the targets are built and which is not in the archive); each example's assets; each example's specs (examples/<example>/tests/specs/<name>.scm) and the fixtures they use (examples/<example>/tests/fixtures); and a generated README.md. All are this repository's own files.

Each example's header names the platform bundle published in the same release, by its content-addressed URL; the compiler fetches it when an example builds, and it is not in the archive. It has its own SBOM beside it.

The starter example's assets/polymorphic-defunctionalization.mp3 (MP3, 44.1 kHz stereo, 92 kb/s, 2:59, byte for byte the gist's compact MP3) and assets/polymorphic-defunctionalization.lrc (byte for byte the gist's timed lyrics), under CC BY 4.0, not the UPL; assets/CREDITS.md attributes them.

coverage.reason: The archive is written by scripts/release.roc on roc-stable and zip, and the tool's package by roc bundle on the latest Roc nightly at release time; the release notes name both compilers under Compilers. Neither adds code of its own.
